title: Group expense splitter that settles who owes whom
when: The user wants to split shared costs of a trip, house or dinner among friends and get the shortest list of payments to settle up.
inputs: expenses with payer and who shared them
prompt:
Goal: Balances that sum to exactly zero and a short list of payments that settles everyone.
Steps:
1. Data: people [] and expenses { id, payer, amountCents, participants[], description }; participants default to everyone.
2. logic.mjs balances(): payer gets plus the amount, each participant minus a share; split in cents and hand leftover cents one by one so shares sum exactly.
3. settle(balances): repeatedly pair the largest debtor with the largest creditor until all are zero; return [{ from, to, amountCents }].
4. UI: add person form, expense form with payer select and a participants checkbox fieldset, expense list with delete, balances table, settlement as sentences "Ana pays Bruno 23.50".
5. Block removing a person used in an expense, with the reason in role="alert".
6. Save the group in localStorage split.v1 guarded.
7. test.mjs: 100.00 over 3 sums to 100.00, balances sum to 0, settle clears all in at most n minus 1 payments.
Quality bar:
- Every cent is accounted for.
- Positive and negative balances are labeled "is owed" and "owes".
- Works one handed on a phone.
Pitfalls:
- Rounding each share and losing a cent.
- Ignoring participants and splitting every expense with all.
- Floating point totals.
Verify:
- [ ] Balances sum to zero.
- [ ] Settlement list matches balances.
- [ ] Forms are labeled.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (balances and settle), test.mjs.

examples.input: dividir as despesas da viagem entre 4 amigos
examples.output: people + expenses forms, balances table, "Carla pays Davi 57.25" list
